notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch
notes.notes:
v1.0.4 Patch Notes

Game Direction Changes
Before Patch
A one-time random defense game, heavily dependent on luck with card selection.

After Patch
A game with enhanced RPG elements where units grow with experience points and skills are enhanced with skill points.

Removed Features

Removed Unit Draw: Units now grow through experience points, and the draw system has been removed.
Removed Stat Cards from Card Draw System: Stat cards have been removed in favor of growth through experience points.
Removed Gem Currency: The gem currency has been removed from the game.


Added Features

Zoom Function: A feature to zoom in and out of the game screen has been added.
Tutorial Added: Basic gameplay instructions for new players have been added.
New Enemy Units Added:

Belt Egg : Has a lot of health.
Crown Egg : Generates a shield that blocks projectiles for 3 seconds when attacked.
Boss trait: Shield always active.
Leaf Egg : Has a chance to evade attacks (25% evasion chance).
Boss trait: 50% evasion chance.
Spike Egg : Creates a short-range nova when attacking, reducing the mana of units hit by the nova by 20.
Boss trait: Mana reduction doubled (40 mana reduction).
Winged Egg : Movement speed increases by 50% when damaged, lasting for 5 seconds.
Boss trait: Always active.
Phoenix Egg : Recovers to 100% health when health falls below 30%.
Boss trait: Revives twice.
Horned Egg : Recovers 10% of max health each time it is attacked.
Boss trait: Recovers 5% of max health each time it is attacked.
Helmet Egg : Takes 1 damage from all attacks.

Runes Added:

Rune that reduces upgrade consumption time
Rune that reduces upgrade consumption cost
Rune that increases damage to bosses



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where rune synthesis did not function correctly.
